supersedes: preregistration.json for information-availability and event-order semantics only

causal_corrections.availability_clock: local_timestamp is the sole event-availability and sequencing clock; exchange timestamp is diagnostic only
causal_corrections.bucket_contract: events whose local timestamps fall in [t,t+100ms) form one completed bucket that is unavailable until t+100ms
causal_corrections.entry: first actual Binance quote with local_timestamp >= completed-bucket availability + preregistered latency
causal_corrections.event_order: strict chronological decision time; score breaks ties only within identical decision time
causal_corrections.quote_state: a carried quote may be used for state for no more than 1000ms, but entry and exit require an actual quote event
causal_corrections.same_timestamp: file sequence is never used favorably; when order cannot be established, choose the strategy-adverse path

development_days: remaining UTC first calendar days of each month in 2022 and 2023 after removing pilot days
selection_days: UTC first calendar day of each month in 2024, unopened until frozen development pass
confirmation_days: UTC first calendar day of each month in 2025, unopened until one frozen 2024 primary
